spec.name: Piano Accordion
spec.description: An Italian mother-of-pearl piano accordion standing upright on its bass end, with a pearl-white piano keyboard, red bellows with gold corners, and a bass grille with buttons.
spec.layout: Standing upright on y=0, resting on its bass-side end. Seen from the front (+Z) the keyboard side is on the model's left (+X) and the bass side on the right (-X). The long axis of the instrument runs along x, with the bellows in the middle. The treble cabinet (x 0.10..0.25) is a tall pearl-white box with a piano keyboard on its +Z face, pearl-white keys with black sharps, a gold-edged grille on top and a chrome register switch block. The bellows (x -0.10..0.10) are red folds with cream pleat lines and gold corner guards. The bass cabinet (x -0.25..-0.10) is a pearl box with a perforated grille and rows of round pearl buttons, a leather strap and a bass-side handle at the back. Mother-of-pearl is shown as iridescent pastel panels (pearl white, pink, aqua, lilac) laid in diamond and chevron inlay on the cabinet faces, with gold trim and rhinestone-like dots.

parts.builds: Treble-side wooden cabinet shell in pearlWhite with inset pearl panels (pink, aqua and lilac diamonds and chevrons) on the sides, top and back, a gold edge trim frame, a top grille with slots in grilleDark, and a chrome register switch block with small switches and gem dots.
parts.attaches: Inner face at x=0.10 meets the bellows at trebleBellows; front face holds the keyboard at keyboardFace.

parts.builds: The piano keyboard on the treble cabinet's +Z face: about 24 ivory white keys in keyIvory with thin gap lines, a raised set of black sharps in keyBlack in the 2/3 grouping, a gold keyboard frame rail above and below, and a pearl key cover strip with a small gold nameplate.
parts.attaches: Sits on keyboardFace on the treble cabinet's front.

parts.builds: The bellows between the cabinets: about 14 accordion folds as alternating wide and narrow frustum slabs in bellowsRed and bellowsDark, pleatCream thin edge lines on each fold ridge, gold corner guards at the four corners in a stack, and a small strap-lock latch in chrome on the front.
parts.attaches: Ends meet the treble cabinet at trebleBellows and the bass cabinet at bassBellows.

parts.builds: Bass-side cabinet in pearlWhite with pearl inlay diamonds in pink, aqua and lilac, a gold edge frame, a perforated grille panel in grilleDark with a gold rim, and six rows of small round pearl bass buttons in pearlWhite with gold rings and a few gem accents on the +Z face.
parts.attaches: Inner face at x=-0.10 meets the bellows at bassBellows; rests on the floor next to the treble cabinet.

parts.builds: Leather shoulder strap in strap on the back (-Z) of both cabinets, with gold buckles and stitched cream trim, a back bass-side hand strap with gold slots, a chrome bellows-strap with a gold clasp wrapped around the bellows, and small gold feet pads under the cabinets.
parts.attaches: Mounted on the back faces of both cabinets, wrapping the bellows at bassBellows and trebleBellows.
